catalogue_requests.summary: Set the source current target to zero with the upstream set(amps=0) safety call; the declared safe state.

notes:
Passed the fake-backend gate with no warnings (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). No hardware was attached and native.py was never imported or run. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card names helper PythonObjectDriver; this package is a decorated direct Driver over modconsmu.modconsmu:smu (the card decision direct-driver is unchanged). PythonObjectDriver cannot pass the keyword arguments set(volts=...) and set(amps=...) of the upstream method or map the tuple returned by update(), so a direct Driver with native.py expresses the two writes, the e-stop and the no-input safe-state action; no wire syntax exists to change. The two numeric writes source_voltage and source_current are Limit.operator_required: no text of the clone states a safe output envelope, maxV=9.93 and minV=-10.45 (modconsmu/modconsmu.py:30-32) are the ends of the driver's conversion scale rather than a rating, and no current bound is stated. Without an operator overlay every one of those writes is refused MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET; site-limits.example.json is an example overlay only (source_voltage -5 to 5 V, source_current -0.05 to 0.05 A) and not a statement about any unit. The upstream API has no separate measurement call: update(mod=1) writes the current target and returns (retVolt, retAmp, modVolt), so each measured read calls update(0), repeats the target the upstream object already holds, and the driver reports that target separately as source_voltage or source_current. The fake is an in-memory ideal-source model, not a recording: its starting values and replies are placeholders and every one is marked with a placeholder comment; there is no upstream simulator or test suite to prefer. The clone documents no independent hardware e-stop, so the package does not claim one: @estop and the safe_state=True action x-cap.itdaniher.source_off.v1 both call the upstream set(amps=0) safety call (modconsmu/modconsmu.py:57-58), which is a software safe state. R2 was chosen from the source-measure output and the clone's charger example (a wrong source can be destructive); the loader refuses this unreviewed model-written package's hardware backend until a human signs reviewed_by, which stays null. Not covered: the GET_NAME and SET_NAME vendor requests (modconsmu/pic/ecs.c:15-16) have no upstream method, the calibration words are read by the upstream constructor and never changed, the upstream constructor calls sys.exit when no USB device is found (modconsmu/modconsmu.py:39-40), and no hardware run was made. There are no arrays in this interface, so no array size is reduced. Every Fact and operator_required reason cites a text file or code line of the clone at 3bddec37c09a408493dab0bf899080670e8807fe; G4 reported no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest the check printed.
